headline: Lola Young partners with CALM on mental health T-shirt
meta_description: Lola Young teams up with mental health charity CALM to launch new Lifelines T-shirt, carrying the message that there is always a reason to keep going.
summary_short: Artist Lola Young has joined forces with mental health charity CALM to create a new Lifelines T-shirt aimed at spreading hope and supporting mental wellness.
body:
Lola Young has partnered with mental health charity CALM to launch a new Lifelines T-shirt designed to carry a message of hope: "There is always a reason to keep going."

The collaboration brings together Young's creative voice with CALM's mission to provide support for people struggling with mental health. The Lifelines T-shirt serves as both a wearable statement and a tangible way to raise awareness about mental wellbeing in everyday life.

By combining art and advocacy, this partnership demonstrates how cultural figures can amplify mental health conversations and remind people that support is available, even in difficult moments.
quick_facts: Lola Young collaborates with mental health charity CALM
New Lifelines T-shirt features hope-centered message
Partnership aims to support mental wellbeing awareness
